The board has changed again after collecting more green objects. Looking at the image:
- There are now green objects in different positions
- 2 green objects at the top (rows ~3-9)
- Some green objects in the middle area
- The player is at the right side
- Purple objects have moved around
This is the same pattern as before - after collecting a batch of green objects, the level rearranges with new green objects appearing. I need to keep collecting them.
Let me check how many green objects remain and collect them all, being careful about the player's position.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state and collect remaining green objects
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
print(f"Player: boundary={player['boundary']}")

green_objects = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green objects: {len(green_objects)}")

# Check which green objects are above the player
player_cols = [p[1] for p in player['boundary']]
player_min_col = min(player_cols)
player_max_col = max(player_cols)
print(f"Player col range: {player_min_col}-{player_max_col}")

for n in green_objects:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    obj_min_col = min(cols)
    obj_max_col = max(cols)
    above = (obj_min_col >= player_min_col - 2 and obj_max_col <= player_max_col + 2)
    print(f"  Green at cols {obj_min_col}-{obj_max_col}, above player: {above}")

# Collect all green objects
clicks = []
for n in green_objects:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col})

action(clicks)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
